summary: Delay's synced times (delayMusical, preSync…): which index is which note value
body: So: 8th = 11, dotted 8th = 13 (3/16), quarter = 14, dotted quarter = 17 (3/8), 8th triplet = 9 (1/12), quarter triplet = 12 (1/6), 16th = 8.
feedback and cross are 0..1; filter is -1..1 (negative darkens the repeats); wet and dry are dB (-96..0). delayMillis adds free time in ms when delayMusical is Off.
